scope: Four explicit old control weeks; causal-order replay of first won-order holding batches. No new worlds or fresh validation seeds.
method: Use only requests and won orders known by each15minute hold flush. Build current note/equipment posts and canonical fees, then compare the incumbent pair planner with net-cost-aware pairs, four-car routes, and a wider route-cost policy. Apply cancellations and changes only when their public events arrive; no final gig stop reconstruction or future outcomes select routes.
limitations: Fixed accepted order stream. Driver reactions, trust, subsequent admission and eventual fees would change in a rollout.
Opening-fee differences are a pricing hypothesis, not realized profit or an upper bound on profit.
The four-car wide policy changes connectors and the share of modeled work saving reflected in pay; it does not isolate route length alone.
Order changes during a hold are excluded at their event time. This is an exposure screen, not an exact action replay.
Enumeration has a30000extension budget per batch. Set packing is exact only for at most20candidates and only among generated routes; larger queues use greedy packing.
